caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved, full-length dress rendered in soft, muted tones of beige and light brown. The dress has a high, empire waistline that sits just below the bust and features a square neckline. The sleeves are voluminous and gathered at the wrists with a cuff or band, creating a billowing effect. The main fabric of the dress is patterned with a small, repeating geometric or floral motif in slightly darker beige or brown, giving the appearance of subtle texture. The lower portion of the dress is adorned with three broad, horizontal bands of solid, slightly darker beige fabric layered one above the other, each accented with faint horizontal lines. The background of the drawing is a light, pale cream color, and the dress stands alone without any accessories or additional objects.
title: Dress
